title: Thermodynamic Response Functions in Singular Bayesian Models
summary: Singular statistical models-including mixtures, matrix factorization, and neural networks-violate regular asymptotics due to parameter non-identifiability and degenerate Fisher geometry. Although singular learning theory characterizes marginal likelihood behavior through invariants such as the real log canonical threshold and singular fluctuation, these quantities remain difficult to interpret operationally.
